name: Translate to Hindi
description: Translate text from any language into natural Hindi
promptTemplate:
Translate the following text into natural, fluent Hindi (Devanagari script). Preserve the meaning, tone, and formatting of the original. If the text is already in Hindi, return it unchanged:

"{{input}}"

IMPORTANT: Return ONLY the Hindi translation. Do NOT include any introductory notes or explanations.
